description: 10-seed AR(1) soft Data variance pilot; session-level paired BER variance/covariance estimation only, no efficacy test.
variance_estimands: per-SNR session-level paired absolute BER difference variance
per-SNR session-level paired relative BER difference variance
cross-SNR covariance of paired relative BER differences
pilot_only_constraints: Use only the existing frozen untrained checkpoint in both arms; do not train or select a P12 checkpoint.
Use four SNR values and 1024 frames per session with ten pre-registered new seeds.
The two arms share the same seed, generated waveform, acquisition estimate, and initial tail; their recursive states then evolve naturally under their respective policies.
Causal timing only: each frame is decoded before that frame's soft Data posterior can affect subsequent frames.
Use the pre-frozen AR(1) dynamics file and SHA-256 recorded in each candidate.

Purpose is session-level variance/covariance estimation only. Do not conduct efficacy, harm, or hypothesis tests; do not add seeds based on interim BER; do not include these seeds in the later formal screen.
All ten seeds complete before any variance summary is generated. If interrupted, preserve and report the incomplete status; no automatic rerun or seed replacement.
This pilot does not establish a BER benefit, no-harm conclusion, long-session saturation, hold, or physical transfer to measured EME links.
